notebooks.title: LOKLOK Pilot: Gemini Persona Agents vs the Rule-Based ABM
notebooks.purpose: This notebook runs a **small, transparent pilot comparison**. It asks a Gemini model to appraise the end state of the same measured persona under the eight A/B/C conditions, then compares the resulting ratings with the final rule-based ABM outputs. **What this is** - A single-shot LLM appraisal proxy per persona and condition. - A descriptive comparison of levels, G0-to-G1 contrasts, and the rank
results: Gemini +2.650 [2.342, 2.967] vs rule-based +0.827; competence +31.15 vs +11.30
Engagement reversed +0.163 vs -0.183; MAE 0.655, RMSE 0.842, r = .269 (Section 6.13)

notebooks.title: LOKLOK qualitative analysis with a local LLM (Colab T4)
notebooks.purpose: **What this notebook does** 1. Cleans the two transcripts (FGD, self-report) and flags noise, repeated fragments and moderator speech. 2. Codes every usable segment with a 25-code codebook using a **local** open model (no text leaves Colab). 3. Verifies every evidence quote against the source text (drops fabricated quotes and counts them). 4. Compares the local model with Claude's first-pass label
results: Qwen 7B zero-shot micro-F1 .193; 32.0% of evidence quotes not exact substrings (Section 6.12.15)

notebooks.title: LOKLOK - Zewail Pump-Probe Gate Ablation
notebooks.purpose: Tests whether the Zewail-inspired attention gate changes the simulated results. Modes: full Zewail gate, gate off, simple exponential decay, half dephasing time, double dephasing time. Same personas and seed across modes; paired within persona. This is a model-internal ablation, not a human attention experiment. Output: `loklok_v8_zewail_ablation_results.zip`
results: Gate off +0.194 [0.127, 0.260]; simple decay +0.110; half tau -0.018 (Section 6.11)
